# Gist

GitHub Gist is a service provided by GitHub that allows users to share code snippets, notes, and other text-based content. It supports both public and private gists, enabling easy sharing and collaboration.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gist/.

## Actions

- **Get Gist** (read-only): Retrieve a specific gist by its ID.
- **List Gists** (read-only): List the authenticated user's gists or all public gists if called anonymously.
- **Check Gist Star** (read-only): Check if a gist is starred.
- **Delete Gist Comment**: Delete a comment on a gist.
- **Get Gist Comment** (read-only): Get a specific comment on a gist.
- **Get Gist Revision** (read-only): Retrieve a specific gist revision.
- **List Gist Comments** (read-only): List comments on a gist.
- **List Gist Commits** (read-only): List the commit history of a gist.
- **List Gist Forks** (read-only): List forks of a gist.
- **List Starred Gists** (read-only): List the authenticated user's starred gists.
- **List User Gists** (read-only): List public gists for a specified GitHub user.
- **Unstar Gist**: Unstar a gist.
- **Update Gist Comment**: Update a Gist comment.
